title: Act 4: Echos of the Past
changeNote:
## 1.4.1 Changes

- Fixed card text showing raw code strings, including calculated damage values and energy icons, when another mod adds cards to a card pool.
- Corrupted Player cards exhausted from hand now burn in place instead of disappearing before their flames play.
- Corrupted Player displays return cards to the game's pool without leaving stale entries or changing mouse behavior in your own hand.
- Ring of the Viper no longer grants extra Artifact stacks based on party size. Each corrupted Silent receives the intended amount in multiplayer.
